Interface WebSessionStore

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
All Known Implementing Classes:
MemoryWebSessionStore
public interface WebSessionStore extends AutoCloseable
Linearizable host storage port. Empty means absent/expired only. Failures throw typed exceptions. Conditional replace validates id/version/kind/creation/deadline and atomically replaces or rotates. Invalidation is terminal; a stale replacement never recreates a missing record. A rotation keeps a consumed-handle termination link until its derived session expires/terminates: read(consumed) is absent, while invalidate(consumed) atomically terminates that derived session. This link contains no credential and never enables callback/token response recovery.
